purpose: Diagnostic safety and adversarial content-review fixture; it is not official guidance, external user validation, or a semantic-entailment benchmark.

historical_split.rule: All regions, scenarios, excerpts, claims, and IDs in this file were newly authored for this holdout.

limitations: Synthetic excerpts do not state real emergency advice and must not be presented as official guidance.
Expected labels specify intended review outcomes only; they do not guarantee semantic accuracy for arbitrary parsers or models.
Citation state is a fixture property, not a verification of any external source.
This small challenge set is diagnostic coverage, not a representative production evaluation.

cases.scenario: A two-row markdown table states a conditional allocation.
cases.evidence_text: [SYN-CED-12] Cedar Bend allocates 6 lanterns to the hall only after a stock check; before that check, the allocation is unconfirmed.
cases.claim_text:
| Place | Lantern allocation |
| --- | --- |
| Cedar Bend Hall | 6, only after a stock check [SYN-CED-12] |

cases.scenario: A long narrative repeats a conditional allocation then reverses it near the end.
cases.evidence_text: [SYN-CED-12] Cedar Bend allocates 6 lanterns to the hall only after a stock check; before that check, the allocation is unconfirmed.
cases.claim_text: The Cedar Bend planning note is deliberately descriptive: it says the hall is the proposed destination for six lanterns, that the number is not a general inventory total, that the notation was copied from a draft planning sheet, that volunteers should not infer delivery timing from the draft, that no separate allocation is stated for the clinic or wharf, that the allocation must remain unconfirmed while the stock check has not occurred, and that any local reader should preserve those qualifications when summarising the note; however, despite those repeated qualifications, the note concludes that six lanterns are already confirmed at the hall before the stock check. [SYN-CED-12]

cases.scenario: A long sentence preserves an exception near its end.
cases.evidence_text: [SYN-MF-13] Moonah Flats marks the eastern track as inspection-only, except for a signed maintenance crew during daylight.
cases.claim_text: The Moonah Flats field note identifies the eastern track for inspection rather than ordinary travel, explains that the marker is intended to prevent a reader from treating the track as a public route, notes that the file gives no promise about its condition beyond the inspection label, separates the track from nearby signed paths, says that the label should not be converted into a general access recommendation, repeats that ordinary visitors are outside the stated exception, and asks a summariser to preserve every qualification when referring to the route; nevertheless, it concludes that even a signed maintenance crew is prohibited from using the eastern track during daylight. [SYN-MF-13]

cases.scenario: A prose restatement removes an explicit exception.
cases.evidence_text: [SYN-MF-13] Moonah Flats marks the eastern track as inspection-only, except for a signed maintenance crew during daylight.
cases.claim_text: The eastern track at Moonah Flats is inspection-only, except that a signed maintenance crew may use it during daylight. [SYN-MF-13]
